units.source_text: 夫人将我介绍给他们之后，说了声“请向先生致意”，

en.t: After the lady introduced me to them, she said, "Please pay your respects to the teacher,"
and the disciples immediately bowed their heads in greeting.

units.source_text: 我感受到这个家庭的温暖。

en.t: I felt the warmth of this household.

units.source_text: 这种礼仪是很自然的，毫无矫揉造作的痕迹。

en.t: This courtesy was very natural, without the slightest trace of affectation.

units.source_text: 少年们一离开客厅，就听见他们在这座宽阔房子里嬉戏的吵嚷声。

en.t: As soon as the boys left the parlor, I could hear the noise of them playing in the spacious house.

units.source_text: 在夫人的劝导下，我登上了二楼，请内弟子同我练习了一盘，

en.t: At the lady's urging, I went upstairs and asked one of the resident disciples to play a practice game with me,

units.source_text: 夫人不时给我端来食物。

en.t: while the lady brought me food from time to time.

units.source_text: 我在这家待了很长时间。

en.t: I stayed at that house for a long time.
